name: Fallback composition
promise: Every section in content order, in one readable column.
description: The host's stand-in. It renders when the selected variant isn't installed, and it renders the contract fixtures and the appearance matrices, every section through the kit's shared renderers. A site can't select it.

sources.source: The variant template's colors, fonts, and theme toggle
sources.note: Color, type, and display mode belong to the appearance axes (#19), not to a composition.
